metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 31 sub-skills and 30 sub-agents, plus 8 optional MCP extensions (DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Unlighthouse). Adds a managed multi-agent backlink acquisition engine (verified baseline audit, competitor gap, prospecting, outreach drafting, independent DOM link verification, and AEO/GEO citation work) alongside the managed cross-platform runtime and safe sitemap discovery.
